subject: french
topicDisplay: Area D: The World Of Work
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in French on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (French↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.explain: Classic false friend: 'passer un examen' means 'to sit/take an exam', not to pass. 'To pass' is 'réussir un examen'.
'Les réseaux sociaux' means 'social networks / social media'. 'Un réseau' is a network.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'Yesterday I worked a lot' (past)?
questions.explain: 'J'ai travaillé' is the perfect tense (completed past) 'I worked'; with 'hier' (yesterday) the perfect is correct.

questions.q: What does « Le prof est exigeant » mean?
questions.explain: « Exigeant » means demanding/strict (from « exiger », to demand).

questions.q: How do you say « My favourite subject is history »?
options: Ma matière préférée est l'histoire vraie
Ma matière préférée, c'est une histoire
questions.explain: « Ma matière préférée » = my favourite subject and « l'histoire » = history (the school subject).

questions.q: Which sentence means « Later I would like to work abroad »?
options: Plus tard je travaille à l'étranger
Hier je voulais travailler à l'étranger
Plus tard je voudrais travailler en équipe
Plus tard je voudrais travailler à l'étranger
questions.explain: « Plus tard » = later and « je voudrais » (conditional) = I would like, so this is the future-aspiration sentence.

questions.q: What does « la récréation » mean (at school)?
questions.explain: At school « la récréation » (« la récré ») means break time between lessons.
« Redoubler » means to repeat/retake a school year because you didn't pass.

questions.q: How do you say « I do a paper round to earn pocket money »?
options: Je distribue des journaux pour gagner de l'argent de poche
Je distribue des journaux pour dépenser de l'argent
Je gagne des journaux pour mon argent de poche
Je lis des journaux pour gagner de l'argent de poche
questions.explain: « Distribuer des journaux » = to deliver papers and « gagner de l'argent de poche » = to earn pocket money.

options: A festive Christmas/New Year's Eve meal
questions.explain: 'Le réveillon' is the late-night feast on Christmas Eve or New Year's Eve. (The verb 'réveiller' means 'to wake', a related distractor.)
« Bien payé » means well paid; the opposite is « mal payé ».

options: The start of the new school year
questions.explain: « La rentrée » is the back-to-school period at the start of the academic year in September.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to be a nurse'?
questions.explain: 'Je voudrais' (conditional) = 'I would like' and 'infirmier' = 'nurse'; 'malade' means 'ill', a near-miss distractor.
« Les devoirs » means homework (« faire ses devoirs » = to do one's homework).
